about: Exact-match twists for resilience.shock_parser. Each phrase is normalized (lowercase, punctuation stripped, spaces collapsed) before matching. 'intent' says what the words mean; resilience.shock_parser.validate_and_build turns it into a Shock for the selected account. 'expect' is the Shock (non-default fields) the intent gives from no shock, checked by tests/test_shock_parser.py; account-relative twists have no 'expect'.

twists.name: README twist 1: laid off, EI at 55%
phrases: Laid off: EI at 55% of usual income
They lose their job and go on EI
The customer is laid off and EI pays 55%
